{{- /* Rendered page HTML with every link to a folded API reference member (a relref to its page, from a guide or from another symbol's page) pointed straight at the member's section on its parent's page (api-member-urls.html): the member has no page of its own. A post-render pass, like guide-body.html's: a link render hook only sees a relref as a placeholder, before Hugo resolves it. Expects: the HTML string. Returns it with the links rewritten. */ -}} {{- $out := . -}} {{- $urls := partialCached "api-member-urls.html" site -}} {{- range findRESubmatch `href="([^"#]*/api-reference/[^"#]*)"` $out | uniq -}} {{- $href := index . 1 -}} {{- with index $urls $href -}} {{- $out = replace $out (printf `href="%s"` $href) (printf `href="%s"` .) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $out -}}
